title: OTP Forwarder Payload
description: Canonical contract between the Android client and the verification-code dashboard server. Both sides MUST conform to this shape. Server-side validation (server/server.js) and the shared JS core (shared/js/otp-core.js) enforce it.

otp.description: The extracted one-time code. Numeric (4-8 digits) or alphanumeric (e.g. ABCD-EFGH).

token.description: Optional push token configured on the client. When present the server MUST check it against ADMIN/ingest token (HTTP 403 otherwise).

source.description: Channel that produced the code. Decided by the client based on the ingestion path, NOT by the extractor.

platform.description: Human-readable brand / service name inferred by the extractor (e.g. 腾讯, Google, 招商银行).

time.description: Local wall-clock time HH:mm:ss at extraction.
